carpet.rule.noThunder.name: No Thunder
carpet.rule.noThunder.desc: Disables thunder caused by the weather cycle
carpet.rule.collectibleSpawnEgg.name: Collectible Spawn Eggs
carpet.rule.collectibleSpawnEgg.desc: Allows players to obtain mob spawn eggs
carpet.rule.largeBucket.name: Large Bucket
carpet.rule.largeBucket.extra.1: Non-player sources (e.g. dispensers) cannot trigger the large bucket effect
carpet.rule.undyingFakePlayer.name: Undying Fake Players
carpet.rule.undyingFakePlayer.desc: Prevents Carpet fake players from taking damage from anything other than the configured sources, and makes them immune to negative effects
carpet.rule.undyingSnowGolem.name: Undying Snow Golems
carpet.rule.undyingSnowGolem.desc: Prevents snow golems from taking damage from anything other than the configured sources, and makes them immune to negative effects
carpet.rule.activeMending.name: Active Mending
carpet.rule.activeMending.desc: When the player has experience and an item with Mending in a configured slot is not at full durability, experience is consumed automatically to repair it
carpet.rule.ripenableSugarcane.name: Ripenable Sugarcane
carpet.rule.ripenableSugarcane.desc: Allows using bone meal on sugarcane
carpet.rule.commandObserverFreezeAreas.d: Allows players to run the observerFreezeAreas command to freeze observers inside an area
carpet.rule.commandObserverFreezeAreas.e: This rule is set with setDefault by default
Allows running villagerTradableItem to reroll villager trades until the wanted item appears
Rerolls follow the vanilla rules: items that are not in the default trade list can never appear
A very large iteration limit (while the target never appears) will block the server tick
carpet.rule.commandHome.name: home command
carpet.rule.commandHome.desc: Allows players to run the home command to return to their respawn point
carpet.rule.fakeBrittleIce.name: Fake Brittle Ice
carpet.rule.fakeBrittleIce.desc: Adds a brittle ice style generation mechanic similar to 26.4, but it generates ice
carpet.rule.hardTurtleEgg.name: Hard Turtle Eggs
carpet.rule.hardTurtleEgg.desc: Turtle eggs do not break when stepped on
carpet.rule.forceTurtleEggHatching.name: Force Turtle Egg Hatching
carpet.rule.forceTurtleEggHatching.desc: Right-clicking a turtle egg with a golden carrot forces it to hatch
carpet.rule.infinityInventory.name: Infinity Inventory
carpet.rule.infinityInventory.desc: Allows players to run the infinityInventory command (gated by permission level)
carpet.rule.infinityInventoryMenu.name: Infinity Inventory Menu
carpet.rule.infinityInventoryMenu.desc: Allows opening the infinity inventory menu with /infinityInventory menu
carpet.rule.infinityInventoryCraftRecurs: Maximum number of recursive intermediate crafting steps when the craft button / shulker box slot lacks materials; 0 disables recursion, 1 allows one level (no hard cap)
carpet.rule.commandInfinityInventorySync: Allows using /infinityInventory sync to request a manual server-side data sync
